title: Chu Tsung Eu

page_data.en:
No
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE, DETECTIVE BRANCH.）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
No 311
Date 5/5/16.
FILED
May 4th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that 1,000 troops who have instructions to move towards Chekiang, left Sungkiang on 2nd inst and proceeded to a place called Zah Woo Daung 乍浦塘 which is on the way to Fung Ching. There are only about one hundred soldiers at Sungkiang now. Half of these are guarding the railway station and the other half are posted at the City gates.
Five hundred recruits who are quartered in the Doo S Koong Su 圖書公司 were supplied with rifles at the Arsenal yesterday.
It is reported that Chen Chi Mei will leave for Japan soon.
It is said that Chiangchun Feng has received a telegram from the Yunnan revolutionaries saying that they have no connection with the rebels in Shanghai.
At 3.10 p.m. 3rd instant seven hundred and fifty infantry, seventy cavalry, and sixty artillery men passed through Shanghai en route from Wusieh to Woosung. These troops were sent from the latter place to Wusieh when that City was threatened by the Kiangyin rebels.
At 5.30 a.m. 4th instant five hundred recruits passed through Shanghai en route from the north to Woosung where they will be trained.
The Cantonese whose arrest on suspicion of being a rebel was referred to in yesterday's report is named Chu Tsung 朱振歐. He came from Japan a few days ago. Chu admits that he came here for the purpose of assassinating General Yang.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLaucland?
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Sent 15.00 ... / ... May 4

编号
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处侦探股。）
上海公共租界工部局。
第 311 号
日期 1916年5月5日。
归档
1916年5月4日。

先生，
据报，奉命向浙江进发的1,000名士兵于本月2日离开松江，前往位于通往枫泾途中的一个名为乍浦塘的地方。目前松江仅有约一百名士兵。其中一半守卫火车站，另一半部署在各城门。
昨日，兵工厂向驻扎在图书公司的五百名新兵配发了步枪。
据报，陈其美即将启程前往日本。
据悉，张勋收到云南革命党人的电报，称他们与上海的反叛者并无关联。
本月3日下午3时10分，七百五十名步兵、七十名骑兵和六十名炮兵经过上海，从吴淞江（Wusieh）前往吴淞。当江阴反叛者威胁该城时，这些部队曾从吴淞派往吴淞江。
本月4日上午5时30分，五百名新兵经过上海，从北方前往吴淞接受训练。
昨日报告中提及因涉嫌是反叛者而被捕的广东人，名为朱振欧。他数日前从日本抵达。朱承认他来此的目的是刺杀杨将军。

您顺从的仆人，
McLaucland?（音译）
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

发送时间 15:00 ... / ... 5月4日
